With a maximum capacity of 136 passengers, you have the freedom to plan a full-team training session or host a small focus group, all for the same great price. Customize your cruise with complimentary non-alcoholic beverages or book caterers, bartenders and on-board entertainers. Set sail with your team to explore wildlife, scenery and a truly remote work environment. Break out of the office and take your team to the great outdoors.
